items.reason: The branch does not run on every hydrated model: app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:222 requires root.__rest_serializer === "1", which app/controllers/application_controller.rb:244-245 adds only explicitly. The opted-in serializers supply no plain group_ids or nullable *_ids; the new relationship is a has_many collection with embedded records (app/serializers/embedding_serializer.rb:3; app/serializers/application_serializer.rb:2), so the claimed regression has no producer in this checkout. The base regex /(.+)\_id$/ also never matched *_ids, contrary to the second comment.
